title.zh: IMF发现：代币化股票需求真实，但仍波动剧烈且流动性不足
title.en: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds

current_state.zh: IMF 10月《全球金融稳定报告》以专门章节覆盖代币化市场，除此前代币化股票的波动性、流动性及交易时段发现外，新增整体代币化RWA市场规模约650亿美元、代币化回购日交易量约3030亿美元等数据，并警告代币化可能成为杠杆与期限错配的新渠道；报告同时指出系统性风险目前仍然有限。
current_state.en: The IMF’s October GFSR now includes a dedicated tokenization chapter, adding overall tokenized RWA market size (~$65B), tokenized repo volumes (~$303B daily) and warnings that tokenization could become a new channel for leverage and maturity/liquidity mismatches, while still assessing systemic risk as limited.

updates.title_zh: IMF发现：代币化股票需求真实，但仍波动剧烈且流动性不足
updates.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
updates.what_changed_zh:
国际货币基金组织（IMF）最新《全球金融稳定报告》发现，超过50%的代币化股票交易发生在美国常规交易时段之外，约80%的交易不足一整股；同时代币化股票的波动率约为标的股票的1.5倍，流动性也明显更差。该报告覆盖了11个交易平台、365天内流动性最好的五只代币化美股，认为目前系统性风险仍然有限，并敦促监管机构考虑为24/7交易设置熔断机制。

IMF表示已敦促监管机构考虑为24/7交易引入熔断机制，并更密切地监测代币化市场与传统市场之间的联系，同时指出目前系统性风险仍然有限。鉴于该市场仍处于早期阶段，IMF还称其结论“应谨慎解读”。

代币化股票市场规模约23亿美元且高度集中，Ondo Finance与Backed Finance的xStocks合计占据逾70%份额；两者发行的均为合成代币，提供价格敞口但不涉及直接持股。传统市场重新开盘时，常规股票吸收了其代币化对应资产隔夜价格波动的87%至99%，而去中心化交易所上的代币化价格偏离传统市场更大。
updates.what_changed_en: The IMF's latest Global Financial Stability Report finds that tokenized stocks see genuine retail demand — most trading happens outside U.S. market hours and in fractional amounts — but these tokens are about 1.5 times more volatile and less liquid than the underlying equities, with systemic risk still contained and regulators urged to consider circuit breakers for 24/7 trading.

updates.background_zh: 报告发布之际，美国金融巨头正加速进入代币化领域：纽约证券交易所计划通过Blockchain.com触达加密投资者；纽交所母公司ICE正与OKX合作，在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）新的创新豁免框架下开展24/7代币化股票交易；Securitize已将代币化的英伟达、苹果和亚马逊股票引入Solana，并计划接入更多区块链网络；Cboe与标普达成代币化期权协议；Coinbase则于8月在Base上为美国以外用户推出代币化股票。今年早些时候，IMF曾警告代币化金融与稳定币可能放大金融危机。
updates.background_en: The report lands as U.S. financial heavyweights push into tokenization: the NYSE plans to reach crypto investors through Blockchain.com, NYSE owner ICE is working with OKX on 24/7 tokenized stock trading under the SEC's new innovation exemption, Securitize has brought tokenized Nvidia, Apple and Amazon shares to Solana, Cboe struck an S&P deal for tokenized options, and Coinbase launched tokenized stocks for non-U.S. users on Base in August. Earlier this year, the IMF warned that tokenized finance and stablecoins could amplify financial crises.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该报告将监管注意力引向代币化股票的市场结构问题——24/7交易时段、熔断机制以及与传统交易场所的联动——这可能影响Ondo Finance、Backed Finance等发行方以及其代币所交易的中心化与去中心化平台的披露与交易规则。报告指出代币化市场规模小、集中度高且流动性薄弱，这关系到此类场所对标的股票市场构成多大传染风险。
updates.market_impact_en: The report focuses regulatory attention on market-structure questions for tokenized equities — 24/7 trading hours, circuit breakers and links to traditional venues — which could shape disclosure and trading rules for issuers such as Ondo Finance and Backed Finance and for the exchanges and DEXs where their tokens trade. Its finding that tokenized markets remain small, concentrated and thinly liquid bears on how much contagion risk these venues pose to underlying equity markets.

updates.title_zh: 【IMF：代币化 RWA 市场规模约 650 亿美元，或成杠杆与流动性风险新渠道】
updates.title_en: 【IMF：代币化 RWA 市场规模约 650 亿美元，或成杠杆与流动性风险新渠道】
updates.what_changed_zh: IMF 10月《全球金融稳定报告》首次用专门章节讨论代币化市场：截至7月底，不含回购和稳定币的代币化RWA公开市场规模约650亿美元（信贷约304亿、货币市场基金约175亿、股票约23亿），代币化回购30日平均日交易量达3030亿美元；并警告代币化资产可能成为杠杆积累及流动性与期限错配的新渠道，以及稳定币/代币化存款作为主要结算工具带来的发行方信用风险和集中度风险。
updates.what_changed_en: The IMF’s October GFSR dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization: tokenized RWA public market (ex repo/stablecoins) was ~$65B as of end-July (credit ~$30.4B, MMFs ~$17.5B, equities ~$2.3B) with tokenized repo 30-day average daily volume at $303B; it warns tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches, and flags stablecoin/tokenized-deposit settlement concentration/credit risks.
updates.current_state_zh: IMF 10月《全球金融稳定报告》以专门章节覆盖代币化市场，除此前代币化股票的波动性、流动性及交易时段发现外，新增整体代币化RWA市场规模约650亿美元、代币化回购日交易量约3030亿美元等数据，并警告代币化可能成为杠杆与期限错配的新渠道；报告同时指出系统性风险目前仍然有限。
updates.current_state_en: The IMF’s October GFSR now includes a dedicated tokenization chapter, adding overall tokenized RWA market size (~$65B), tokenized repo volumes (~$303B daily) and warnings that tokenization could become a new channel for leverage and maturity/liquidity mismatches, while still assessing systemic risk as limited.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The IMF's October Global Financial Stability Report dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization, sizing the tokenized RWA market at roughly $65B (credit $30.4B, MMFs $17.5B, equities $2.3B) alongside $303B in average daily tokenized repo volume, flagging concentrated equity issuance, thin liquidity and 1.5x volatility, and warning that tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The IMF's October Global Financial Stability Report dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization, sizing the tokenized RWA market at roughly $65B (credit $30.4B, MMFs $17.5B, equities $2.3B) alongside $303B in average daily tokenized repo volume, flagging concentrated equity issuance, thin liquidity and 1.5x volatility, and warning that tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches.
